output.reason: [ev-5714a6388637] and [ev-0ab8730da6d7] show the storage flag moving from v2beta1 to v2 between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0. Per the change text, every CleanupPolicy object that already exists stays stored as v2beta1, whichever apiVersion its manifest uses. The proposed condition only matches manifests whose apiVersion is v2beta1, so it misses objects written as v2 that are still stored as v2beta1. It also wraps the value in extra quotes ("\"kyverno.io/v2beta1\""), so it would never match. The exposure is any CleanupPolicy in use when upgrading from a release before 1.13.0.

correction.statement: Environments that have kyverno.io CleanupPolicy objects (any apiVersion) and upgrade from a release before 1.13.0 are exposed: those objects stay stored as v2beta1 after v2 becomes the storage version, until they are rewritten and status.storedVersions is updated.
